Thanks Vivek — I can take CSM lead as proposed. Below is a 30/60/90 viewpoint and a short risk register so the team has guardrails.

30 days (pre-cutover) — primary objectives:
- Validate VPC peering and private egress routing with Clarity ops (contact: oncall_ops@clarityhealth.com)
- Confirm cert rotation cadence and push timeline for KMS/HSM access
- Run smoke tests with pinned model variant and confirm token/per-minute cost estimates

60 days (post-cutover stabilization) — primary objectives:
- Monitor quality regressions (prompt sets) and configure auto-rollbacks if generation score drops below threshold
- Tune cache TTLs and prefix priming windows; implement temporary hot-cache for their top 50 prompts

90 days (operationalize) — primary objectives:
- Handover to Standard CS cadence: weekly check-ins, monthly health report, alerting thresholds

Risks & mitigation:
- Missing DocuSign / delayed SOW — mitigation: Aditya to confirm EOD Tue; if delayed, postpone billing start by 1 billing cycle and update finance
- Access bottlenecks for their cloud account — mitigation: temporary service account via SFTP; Clarity to provide service-account JSON to our secure intake (instructions attached)
- Model degradation due to quant differences — mitigation: stage with both quant variants and run A/B smoke for 24 hours
